closed_world_boundary: The foundation metamodel, record kinds, validation gates and refusal states are closed for an edition.
open_world_registries: vertical research packs and analytical cases

coverage_dimensions.question: What is classified: activity, product, provider, purpose/function, regulatory line, criticality, institutional sector or another concept?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Concept is missing or axes are collapsed.

coverage_dimensions.question: Which classification series and immutable edition own the code?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Only an unversioned code or scheme family is supplied.

coverage_dimensions.question: What entity or observation is assigned to the category?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Establishment, enterprise, provider, product and transaction are conflated.

coverage_dimensions.question: Are every level, parent, child, code and title in the imported source accounted for?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Counts, parents, leaves or official rows do not reconcile.

coverage_dimensions.question: Are definitions, inclusions, exclusions, residual categories and assignment rules available?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: A title or code is treated as a sufficient semantic definition.

coverage_dimensions.question: What jurisdiction and territorial implementation apply?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: A national extension is treated as globally valid.

coverage_dimensions.question: What validity period, adoption state, transition and historical edition apply?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Observations from different editions are pooled silently.

coverage_dimensions.question: Are mapping relation, cardinality, extent, loss and allocation semantics explicit?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Corresponding codes are asserted as simple equality.

coverage_dimensions.question: Which specialist axes are necessary for this vertical: provider, function, product, regulatory, criticality, geography, value-chain role or other?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: The ISIC spine is assumed to contain every domain distinction.

coverage_dimensions.question: Does each claim resolve to an authoritative source, locator, status and limitation?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Evidence is indirect, stale, missing or outside authority scope.

coverage_dimensions.question: Does each vertical pack bind its industry_id and subindustry_ids to registered edition-qualified nodes or declared local extensions?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Free-text industry labels or unregistered IDs are used.

coverage_dimensions.question: Does every subindustry pack enumerate decision-bearing analytical cases rather than merely KPIs?
coverage_dimensions.gap_if: Metrics are presented without question, actors, grain, method, evidence, failure and action.

gates.pass_condition: At least 25 verified authoritative sources from at least 10 publishers, with required shared source-evidence fields.
Official source digest matches; exactly 22 sections, 87 divisions, 258 groups and 463 classes form one acyclic hierarchy of 830 unique nodes.
Every industry node has an immutable edition-qualified stable ID and every reference resolves.
Every scheme declares concept, statistical unit, geography, time, hierarchy, assignment rules, role, evidence and limitations.
Every mapping validates relation, cardinality, aggregation, five compatibility dimensions, loss, allocation, evidence and review posture.
gates.failure_action: Mapping cannot be used for compilation or analytics.

gates.pass_condition: Each industry-family pack carries at least 25 authoritative sources; foundation sources do not count automatically unless directly relevant and explicitly referenced.
gates.failure_action: Vertical pack remains sourced_candidate at best.

gates.pass_condition: Every in-scope registered leaf or explicitly justified aggregation has analytical-case, source-system and data-shape coverage or a typed gap.
gates.failure_action: No claim of complete subindustry coverage.

gates.pass_condition: Cases satisfy the shared analytical-case schema and include diagnostic, causal/RCA, constraint/bottleneck, predictive, prescriptive, optimization, simulation, risk and control modes where applicable, each with evidence or a typed not-applicable decision.
Product boundaries derive only after vertical cases are deduplicated against horizontal semantic owners and operational capabilities.
gates.failure_action: Taxonomy category cannot be promoted directly to product.

anti_completion_claims: Importing all ISIC codes does not prove all industry analytics needs are known.
Twenty-five sources across the foundation do not satisfy the separate twenty-five-source requirement for each industry family.
A green schema validator proves structural conformance, not semantic correctness or domain completeness.
A published correspondence table does not prove lossless time-series recoding.
A large number of cases does not prove coverage unless each registered scope cell is accounted for.
